purpose: S4 third conflict-closure native family extension. Registers the already-implemented fee-token-cw20 family for review bases that were bootstrapped from the narrower S4 candidate map, and adds the V3 pool alias as a conservative per-pool singleton dependency abstraction. Neither mapping is an EVM execution/state equivalence claim.

fee-token-cw20.semantic_scope: fungible token with transfer policy/fee/router state

v3-pool-lock.semantic_scope: Observed S4 Uniswap-V3 pool swap class modeled as an independent pool instance with a singleton pool-state dependency lock. This conservatively preserves same-pool cross-transaction dependency/conflict structure without modeling ticks, liquidity math, token settlement, or claiming EVM/Uniswap-V3 execution equivalence.
